title: Aromatic Smoky Polish Potatoes Grill
description: A light and bitter Polish dish featuring grilled potatoes, perfect for a monsoon day, made dairy-free-friendly using a binchotan grill.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the potato slices for about 5 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the potatoes from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Drizzle the grilled potatoes with lemon juice and serve immediately.
Let the potatoes cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the Aromatic Smoky Polish Potatoes Grill hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
